projects.name: Analytics Dashboard Platform
projects.description:
Build an internal analytics dashboard that consolidates three data sources into one reporting surface:
1. Customer CSV files (ingested from business systems, schema varies by export)
2. Application log files (structured/unstructured logs from services)
3. Visualization layer (dashboards, charts, filters, drill-downs)

Scope of this plan covers milestones for discovery & foundation, CSV ingestion, log analysis, unified data model, visualization components, and hardening/release. Each milestone is decomposed into tasks sized to be executable individually (complexity <= 6/10). Out of scope for now: real-time streaming ingestion, ML forecasting, and write-back into source systems.

Tags: analytics, dashboard, data-pipeline, visualization

tasks.name: Inventory the customer CSV exports: list each source system, export cadence, delimiter/encoding, column meanings, and known data quality issues.
tasks.details:
## Milestone 1 — Discovery & Foundation
- Inventory the customer CSV exports: list each source system, export cadence, delimiter/encoding, column meanings, and known data quality issues.
- Inventory application log sources: services, log formats (JSON/plaintext), severity conventions, retention windows, and timestamp formats.
- Define the KPI catalogue: name, business definition, formula, source field, granularity.
- Choose the tech stack and repository structure (ingestion, transform, API, UI)....

tasks.details:

- Implement data quality checks: required fields, null thresholds, duplicate customer IDs, referential checks.

tasks.name: Design the canonical warehouse schema: customer dimension, event fact, log metrics fact, date dimension.
tasks.details:
## Milestone 4 — Unified Data Model & Serving Layer
- Design the canonical warehouse schema: customer dimension, event fact, log metrics fact, date dimension.
- Implement migrations and schema versioning.
- Implement the transformation/orchestration job graph with idempotent runs and dependency ordering.
- Build the query API endpoints that serve dashboard aggregates.
- Add caching and pagination for aggregate queries.

tasks.name: Seed a realistic dataset and run an end-to-end pipeline rehearsal.
tasks.details:
## Milestone 6 — Hardening & Release
- Seed a realistic dataset and run an end-to-end pipeline rehearsal.
- Load/performance test the query API and dashboard.
- Write operational runbook and alerting for pipeline failures.
- Conduct UAT with business stakeholders and triage findings.
- Deploy to staging then production with a rollback plan.
